main_text.head: JOH-HENRICI ALSTEDI TECHNOLOGIA: ID EST PRÆCOGNITORUM PHILOSOPHICORUM PARS TERTIA: Quæ tractat de numero, ordine, differentiis, & proprietatibus singularum disciplinarum, quatenus præcognosci debent.
main_text.p: HActenus explicavimus naturam philosophiæ in archelogia & hexilogia, duobus præcognitis philosophicis:nunc restat tertium philosophiæ præcognitum, quod explicat ejus naturam, nempe Technologia.
Technologia igitur est tertium philososo-Technologia.phiæ præcognitum, quod ejus naturam explicat commemoratione disciplinarum ipsarum.

Disciplinæ sunt internæ, vel externæ. Internæ Disciplinæ funt inter-næ,sunt ipsi habitus intellectuales hominem perficientes, & aptum reddentes ad artificiosè contemplandum, vel operandum. Timpler. in technol.c.4. De hisce velhabitibus nos tractavimus in hexilogia. Vocantur Externæ.aliàs disciplinæ archetypæ, habituales, & concepta.

page.notes: The ornamental mark below the last line (a small printer's ornament, not a catchword or signature) is left out. The drop cap "H" is joined to "Actenus" as printed ("HActenus"). The ct ligature in "Actenus" and "ectypæ" is read as ct. Printed "philosophicis:nunc" has no space after the colon; left as printed. The right-margin note "Technolo-/gia." is written as one note, "Technologia." The "vel" note and the "Externæ." note are placed beside the nearest lines of text, as their vertical position on the scan is approximate. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, so the paragraph continues on the next page. Title and chapter heads were read from the scan as printed; the page has no catchword or signature.
